environment.description: Container deployed on k8s with Pod Security Standard 'restricted' profile enforced at namespace level via PodSecurity admission controller. The container spec sets securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true with no emptyDir or hostPath volume mounts defined. The container image uses a distroless base (gcr.io/distroless/python3-debian12) with no shell binary, no package manager, and no writable tmpfs. The pod spec does not define any volumeMounts or volumes. The OCI runtime spec generated by containerd sets all mount points as 'ro,nosuid,nodev,noexec'. Process /proc/self/fd writes are blocked by the seccomp profile (based on RuntimeDefault with additional restriction on openat with O_WRONLY|O_RDWR flags to paths outside the application's stdout/stderr). Network policy restricts egress to only the MQTT broker on port 8883.
